spec.title: Obsidian Aqueduct
spec.conceptPrompt: Ancient obsidian sluices rise above emerald channels; variable-reel ways tumble, and each winning reel raises its water-level multiplier, combined by addition.
spec.summary: 가변 높이 릴의 Ways와 텀블 구조입니다. 당첨에 참여한 릴의 수문 수위가 단계적으로 오르고 릴 배수가 성장하며, 해당 Ways의 릴 배수를 합산해 지급합니다. 수위는 베이스 스핀마다 초기화되고 프리 스핀 전체에는 유지됩니다.

themeBible.theme: An expedition restores an ancient obsidian aqueduct whose jeweled sluices rise with each successful flow.
themeBible.lighting: Gold light catches the waterline of each sluice above deep navy stone, with restrained emerald reflections. Keep ordinary play restrained; expand the scene on actual growth, unlocks or collection, and stage the climax only for a corresponding large payout.
themeBible.materials: Carved obsidian and navy stone, antique gold sluice mechanisms, emerald valve gems and dark reflective water.
forbidden: Real brands, logos, branded place names or actual gambling venues
Real people, celebrities, personal information or identifiable likenesses
Existing game or film characters, copyrighted mascots or other borrowed IP
Safety claims for lower tiers, guaranteed profit or return promises
Price promises or purchase-cost claims in art
Implying that extreme wins or the maximum payout occur frequently
Using animation delays or waiting time to communicate volatility
Changing RNG, probabilities, prices or feature eligibility through art
Letters or numbers baked into symbol art except original card-rank symbols; render values and feature labels separately
Frogs, rainforest canopies, vines, tropical birds, flowers and butterfly premiums
themeBible.styleKeywords: sculptural illustrated relief, deep navy shadows, emerald gems and antique gold, crisp silhouette, obsidian-sluice, original unbranded art

vfxBriefs.prompt: 기대 연출(Anticipation, 0928): 스캐터를 기다리는 그 릴 둘레에만, 이 게임의 테마 색(주 #08644D, 밝은 #DCE7C7)으로 빛나는 얇은 빛 테두리와 흑요석 수문과 에메랄드 밸브 조각의 3D 오브젝트(테마 vfx-model 메시) 입자가 릴을 따라 아래에서 위로 천천히 흐르고, 릴이 멈출 때까지 이어진다. 긴장감은 빛의 맥동과 입자 속도로 만들고 화면 전체를 덮지 않는다.
vfxBriefs.negative: yellow / gold as the main colour, default_coin / default_star / default_shard meshes, crowns or chests, camera moves, full-screen flashes
